sections.title: S1: WARM UP
sections.description:
Warm up 

a. 1 round of:
60/60 sec Dynamic Pec stretch 
60/60 sec Dynamic Lat stretch 
60/60 sec Dynamic Anterior hip stretch 
60/60 sec Dynamic Posterior hip stretch
 
b. 4 min Echo bike (Easy-Moderate tempo)

c. 1 round of:
Mini-band hinge prep routine (20 Alt. Side steps, 20 Goodmornings, 20 Glute bridges)
20 Alt. Front rack shoot throughs
10 Good-mornings

d. Clean barbell prep:
From High hang: 3 Clean Pulls + 3 Muscle Clean + 3 Power clean
-Rest as needed-
From Low Hang: 3 Clean Pulls + 3 Muscle Clean + 3 Power clean
-Rest as needed-
From Mid shin: 3 Clean Pulls + 3 Muscle Clean + 3 Power clean

attachments.title: From Low hang: (Below knees) 3 Clean Pulls + 3 Muscle Cleans + 3 Power Cleans
From high hang: (Mid thigh) 3 Clean Pulls + 3 Muscle Cleans + 3 Power Cleans

Lat pulsed stretching with reach through

sections.title: S1: STRENGTH-SPEED (Clean)
sections.description:
Strength-Speed / "Power" / Weightlifting, Power Clean

a. Build to a heavy 3 Position Power Clean of the day: 
1 Power Clean from the floor + 1 Power Clean from below the knees + 1 Power clean from above the knees.

b. 3 sets, Going every 2nd minute
3 Position Power clean at 85% of heaviest set in part “a”.

Progression:
W1: 3 Position Power Clean + Back off sets (3x1)  (Current)
W2: 2 Position Power Clean + Back off sets (4x2)
W3: 1 Power Clean + Back off sets (5x1)
W4: Transition week
----------------------------------

sections.title: S1: ABSOLUTE STRENGTH (Front Squat)
sections.description:
Absolute Strength, Anterior Lower-body (Squat)

a. Build to a 5RM Front Squat

b. 3 sets, Going every 3rd minute
Set 1: 5 Front Squats at 85% of 5RM
Set 2: 5 Front Squats at 85% of 5RM
Set 3: Max Front Squats at 85% of 5RM 

Tempo: Controlled decent, As aggressive and strong upwards as possible. Rest as needed in the top. (20X1)

Optional -- > Bands / Chains (accomodating resistance): If you’re up for it and have access to either 2 bands or chains, I’d recommend incorporating accommodating resistance. It’s an effective tool for addressing sticking points and creating a more even resistance profile throughout the lift. This matches the strength curve - making the lift harder where you are strongest (the top) and lighter where you are weakest (the bottom). 
Bands/chains are not mandatory though, so no stress if you don't want to bother setting it up.

Progression:
W1: 5RM Front Squats + 5/5/5+ at 85% of 5RM (current)
W2: 3RM Front Squats + 3/3/3+ at 85% of 3RM
W3: 1RM Front Squats + 1/1/1+ at 85% of 1RM
W4: Transition week.
----------------------------------

sections.title: S1: STRENGTH ENDURANCE (Hinge)
sections.description:
Strength Endurance, Posterior Lower-body (hinge) (+Absolute speed touches)

a. 3 sets, Rest 2 minutes between
8 Deficit Romanian deadlifts (Stand on a 20kg plate)

Optional -- > Absolute speed add-on: 2 Seated Broad jumps to box after each set of RDL's. (Sit on a bench and jump onto a 20inch box place 1.5-3m away from you)

Target / Suggested loads to aim for: Suggested loads below:
[Elite] 100-120+/70-85+kg | 225-265+/155-185+lbs
[RX]  80-100/55-70kg | 185-225/125-155lbs
[Intermediate] 60-80/40-55kg | 135-185/95-125lbs

Tempo: Controlled descent, stop right before the bar hits the floor, fast up. Quality and control are key. Straps are if grip is being a limiter

Intent: Improve muscle endurance and strength qualities in hinging exercises.
----------------------------------

sections.title: S1: CONDITIONING (Threshold)
sections.description:
Conditioning, “Lifting the roof” (V02 max │ 90+% Effort │ Severe-Extreme intensity domain │ Z4-5)

Elite:
a. 3-4 sets, Work:Rest 1:1 (“You Go, I Go”)
15 Hang Squat Cleans
15/11 Cal Row
15m (50ft) Front rack walking lunges
15 Bar facing Burpees
♀ 36kg │ 80lbs
♂ 52kg │ 115lbs

RX 
a. 3-4 sets, Work:Rest 1:1 (“You Go, I Go”)
15 Hang Squat Cleans
15/11 Cal Row
15m (50ft) Front rack walking lunges
15 Bar facing Burpees
♀ 29kg │ 65lbs
♂ 43kg │ 95lbs

Intermediate
a. 3-4 sets, Work:Rest 1:1 (“You Go, I Go”)
10 Hang Squat Cleans
15/11 Cal Row
10m (50ft) Front rack walking lunges
15 Bar facing Burpees
♀ 29kg │ 65lbs
♂ 43kg │ 95lbs

Score: Slowest set of the 3-4 (Make sure to put a comment with what level you completed the workout at)

Work:Rest 1:1 (“You Go, I Go”) = Rest as long as it took you to complete the work or do it with a partner and start as soon as your teammate is done.

sections.title: S1: (OPTIONAL) STRENGTH ACCESSORY
sections.description:
(Optional) Strength Accessory

a.  2-3 sets for quality: (rest as needed between)
A “Tough” set of Loaded GHD hip extensions
A “Tough” set of Banded Hamstring curls

A "tough" set: Stop 2-4 reps before failure.
The goal is to get 10+ reps on the GHD hip extensions (load accordingly) and hit 20+ reps on the hamstring curls.

sections.title: S2: CONDITIONING
sections.description:
Conditioning, Ski and Echo bike (Increasing effort sets)

a. 5 rounds of (20 minutes)
2 minute Ski
2 minute Echo bike
(“Easy” - Conversation pace / Z2 / RPE 3-4 / Moderate

b. 3 sets, (30 minutes)
90 sec Ski (Easy - 6 RPE)
60 sec Ski (Moderate - 7.5 RPE)
30 sec Ski (Hard - 9 RPE)
-Rest 2 minutes-
90 sec Echo bike (Easy - 6 RPE)
60 sec Echo bike (Moderate - 7.5 RPE)
30 sec Echo bike (Hard - 9 RPE)
-Rest 2 minutes-

Progression: (Intensity Density progression)
W1: 90 sec Easy, 60 sec Moderate, 30 sec Hard (current)
W2: 75 sec Easy, 60 sec Moderate, 45 sec Hard
W3: 60 sec Easy, 60 sec Moderate, 60 sec Hard
W4: Transition week.
